texts: You’ve already completed your first check-in. Now, try to support yourself and improve how you feel.
You can use the tools in the app or have a session with a psychologist — choose whatever feels most comfortable for you.
Once you’re done, come back here and rate how you feel again.
It’s best to re-evaluate your well-being throughout the day to see changes.
Rate how you feel before and after your CBT exercises. Regular check-ins help you notice progress and understand how you’re moving forward.
You can choose the format that works best for you. We suggest two options:
First, do a check-in in the morning. Throughout the day, complete exercises, try new experiments, or work with a psychologist. In the evening, rate how you feel again to see changes.
Or, rate your well-being right before you start working in the app or a session with a psychologist, and then again immediately after you finish your exercises.
Both ways are equally helpful. Choose the one that suits you best.
This score reflects how productively you’ve worked in the app — it takes several important parameters into account.
The higher your score, the more confidently and quickly you’re moving toward improving your mental well-being.
